newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway central bank sold 15.5 bln NOK Jan. 8-10.
newsitem.headline: Norway central bank sold 15.5 bln NOK Jan. 8-10.

text.p: The Norwegian central bank said on Thursday it sold a net 15.5 billion crowns for foreign currency between Wednesday and Friday last week.
But the bank, whose target is to maintain a stable currency, has sold 32.93 billion crowns so far this year in efforts to keep the crown from appreciating too much.

The bank cut official interest rates by 25 basis points last Friday and announced it would reduce intervention on the foreign exchange market, leaving the strong crown to float under the market's forces for an unspecified period of time.
